.. change::
    :tags: bug, mssql, reflection
    :tickets: 13497

    Fixed reflection of Microsoft SQL Server ``DATETIME2(p)``,
    ``DATETIMEOFFSET(p)`` and ``TIME(p)`` columns, where the fractional-seconds
    precision ``p`` was not reflected, causing reflect-then-create round trips
    to silently change the column to the default scale of 7.  The precision
    reported by ``sys.columns.precision`` is now assigned to the reflected
    type.  Pull request courtesy Aryan Pardeshi.
